id_scheme: Hierarchical stable IDs: dr.N delivery rule, ms.N milestone, ms.N.f.M milestone feature, ms.N.ac.M milestone acceptance criterion, lb.N label/ordering rule, tc.N testing/CI item, rk.N risk. IDs are stable across edits to ROADMAP.md; new entries get the next free number.

sections.title: Delivery rules
sections.grouping_decision: Each sentence of the Delivery rules paragraph is a distinct cross-cutting rule (dr.*). Kept separate; none merged.

items.title: Every milestone ships migrations, typed configuration, structured logs, health signals, tests, documentation, and an upgrade note.
items.raw: Every milestone ships migrations, typed configuration, structured logs, health signals, tests, documentation, and an upgrade note.

items.title: Do not begin live connector work until mock/recorded contract fixtures and secret handling exist.
items.raw: Do not begin live connector work until mock/recorded contract fixtures and secret handling exist.

sections.title: Milestones
sections.grouping_decision: Each table row is a milestone group (ms.N). Every semicolon-separated prioritized issue inside the 'Prioritized issues / acceptance criteria' cell is indexed as its own feature (ms.N.f.M) with its priority (P0/P1) preserved - no features merged. The trailing acceptance sentence of the cell is indexed as ms.N.ac.M. The ✅ marker on ms.6.f.1 is preserved as status=done.

acceptance_criteria.title: A fresh deployment migrates, authenticates, and exposes readiness.
acceptance_criteria.raw: A fresh deployment migrates, authenticates, and exposes readiness.

acceptance_criteria.title: Re-running a sync produces no duplicate facts/events.
acceptance_criteria.raw: Re-running a sync produces no duplicate facts/events.

features.title: OpenBB gateway and cache policy
features.raw: P0: OpenBB gateway and cache policy

acceptance_criteria.title: Cached data honors TTL and records provenance/freshness.
acceptance_criteria.raw: Cached data honors TTL and records provenance/freshness.

acceptance_criteria.title: Consumer failure retries without source data loss.
acceptance_criteria.raw: Consumer failure retries without source data loss.

features.title: versioned plugin SDK and compatibility policy
features.raw: ✅ P0: versioned plugin SDK and compatibility policy

acceptance_criteria.title: Third-party plugin can be installed/configured without core source edits.
acceptance_criteria.raw: Third-party plugin can be installed/configured without core source edits.

sections.title: GitHub labels and issue ordering
sections.grouping_decision: Each sentence of the labels/ordering paragraph is a distinct rule (lb.*); the label taxonomy list is one item (lb.1).

items.title: Use labels area:api, area:connector, area:data, area:enrichment, area:exporter, area:ops, security, good-first-issue, blocked:provider, plus priority:P0/P1/P2.
Close milestones only after automated acceptance tests run against PostgreSQL/Redis and recorded provider fixtures.
items.raw: Close milestones only after automated acceptance tests run against PostgreSQL/Redis and recorded provider fixtures.

items.title: Provider secrets and real account data are never prerequisites for ordinary CI.
items.raw: Provider secrets and real account data are never prerequisites for ordinary CI.

sections.title: Testing and CI/CD
sections.grouping_decision: Each bullet is a distinct testing/CI item (tc.*). None merged.

items.title: Unit tests: domain policies/mappers with no I/O.
items.raw: Unit tests: domain policies/mappers with no I/O.

items.title: Integration tests: async SQLAlchemy repositories, migrations, Redis locks/rate limits, outbox, with ephemeral PostgreSQL/Redis containers.
items.raw: Integration tests: async SQLAlchemy repositories, migrations, Redis locks/rate limits, outbox, with ephemeral PostgreSQL/Redis containers.

items.title: Contract tests: connectors and exporters against provider/consumer fixtures; live tests are opt-in and secret-gated.
items.raw: Contract tests: connectors and exporters against provider/consumer fixtures; live tests are opt-in and secret-gated.

items.title: E2E tests: API-to-worker flow verifies exactly-once observable outcome after at-least-once delivery.
items.raw: E2E tests: API-to-worker flow verifies exactly-once observable outcome after at-least-once delivery.

items.title: Quality gates: Ruff format/lint, pyright (strict for app/), pytest + coverage threshold ratcheted to 85% minimum, dependency/SBOM/image scans, OpenAPI diff, migration upgrade test.
items.raw: Quality gates: Ruff format/lint, pyright (strict for `app/`), pytest + coverage threshold ratcheted to 85% minimum, dependency/SBOM/image scans, OpenAPI diff, migration upgrade test.

items.title: CI runs pull-request checks; a protected release pipeline builds immutable image tags, scans/signs them, runs migration job, deploys a staging stack, then promotes through Coolify. Production rollback is application-image rollback plus backward-compatible migration strategy—not blind schema downgrade.
items.raw: CI runs pull-request checks; a protected release pipeline builds immutable image tags, scans/signs them, runs migration job, deploys a staging stack, then promotes through Coolify. Production rollback is application-image rollback plus backward-compatible migration strategy—not blind schema downgrade.

sections.title: Risks and mitigations
sections.grouping_decision: Each table row is a distinct risk (rk.N) with its mitigation kept as a separate field; risk and mitigation are not merged into one title.

items.title: Provider APIs change, limit, or omit history
items.mitigation: Connector versioning, fixtures, capability declaration, backoff, manual sync/reconciliation.
items.raw: Provider APIs change, limit, or omit history | Connector versioning, fixtures, capability declaration, backoff, manual sync/reconciliation.

items.title: Ambiguous ticker identity
items.mitigation: ISIN/FIGI-first resolver, listing model, confidence score and review queue.
items.raw: Ambiguous ticker identity | ISIN/FIGI-first resolver, listing model, confidence score and review queue.

items.title: Duplicate/mutating transactions
items.mitigation: Provider identity + fingerprint uniqueness, status/revision handling, outbox idempotency.
items.raw: Duplicate/mutating transactions | Provider identity + fingerprint uniqueness, status/revision handling, outbox idempotency.

items.title: Stale/incomplete valuation
items.mitigation: Per-field freshness, price provenance, coverage/caveats in every aggregate.
items.raw: Stale/incomplete valuation | Per-field freshness, price provenance, coverage/caveats in every aggregate.

items.title: Credential/financial-data exposure
items.mitigation: Envelope encryption, scoped access, redaction, audit, backups, security scans.
items.raw: Credential/financial-data exposure | Envelope encryption, scoped access, redaction, audit, backups, security scans.

items.title: Exporter API mismatch
items.mitigation: Isolated adapters, integration contract tests, delivery cursor and dead-letter visibility.
items.raw: Exporter API mismatch | Isolated adapters, integration contract tests, delivery cursor and dead-letter visibility.

items.title: Premature distributed complexity
items.mitigation: Modular-monolith boundaries; extract only after measured operational need.
items.raw: Premature distributed complexity | Modular-monolith boundaries; extract only after measured operational need.
